001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * History log record TIPS Error, opCode 419, size 26.
009 *
010 * <br>
011 *
012 * 
013 * <table border='1'>
014 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
015 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>419</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
016 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"TIPS Error"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
017 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>internalName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"LID_TIPS_ERROR"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
018 * </table>
019 */
020@HistoryLogProps(
021    opCode = 419,
022    displayName = "TIPS Error",
023    internalName = "LID_TIPS_ERROR"
024)
025public class TipsErrorHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
026
027    private int messageType;
028    private int requestCode;
029    private int errorCode;
030    private boolean isDataMasked;
031
032    public TipsErrorHistoryLog() {}
033    public TipsErrorHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int messageType, int requestCode, int errorCode, boolean isDataMasked) {
034        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
035        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, messageType, requestCode, errorCode, isDataMasked);
036        this.messageType = messageType;
037        this.requestCode = requestCode;
038        this.errorCode = errorCode;
039        this.isDataMasked = isDataMasked;
040    }
041
042    public TipsErrorHistoryLog(int messageType, int requestCode, int errorCode, boolean isDataMasked) {
043        this(0, 0, messageType, requestCode, errorCode, isDataMasked);
044    }
045
046    public int typeId() {
047        return 419;
048    }
049
050    /**
051     * <table border="1">
052     * <caption>Parsed fields for TipsErrorHistoryLog:</caption>
053     * <tr><td><code>messageType</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
054     * <tr><td><code>requestCode</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>errorCode</code></td><td><code>raw[12] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>isDataMasked</code></td><td><code>raw[13] != 0</code></td></tr>
057     * </table>
058     */
059    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
060        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
061        this.cargo = raw;
062        parseBase(raw);
063        this.messageType = raw[10] & 0xFF;
064        this.requestCode = raw[11] & 0xFF;
065        this.errorCode = raw[12] & 0xFF;
066        this.isDataMasked = raw[13] != 0;
067    }
068
069    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int messageType, int requestCode, int errorCode, boolean isDataMasked) {
070        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
071            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(419, 0), // 419 = 0x01A3
072            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
073            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
074            new byte[]{(byte) messageType},
075            new byte[]{(byte) requestCode},
076            new byte[]{(byte) errorCode},
077            new byte[]{(byte)(isDataMasked ? 1 : 0)}));
078    }
079
080    public int getMessageType() {
081        return messageType;
082    }
083
084    public int getRequestCode() {
085        return requestCode;
086    }
087
088    public int getErrorCode() {
089        return errorCode;
090    }
091
092    public boolean isDataMasked() {
093        return isDataMasked;
094    }
095}
